note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-13; reciprocal negatives against chat-harness-knowledge-and-memory/chat-harness-instructions-and-guardrails/chat-harness-tools-resources-and-services/llm-provider-gateway/llm-jsonl-streaming added 2026-07-13 per independent audit). Positives: imperative / diagnostic / symptom / indirect phrasings across the three axes (a10 chain-of-command decomposition, a11 typed hand-off contracts, a12 deterministic pipelines vs ad hoc dispatch). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: chat-harness-skills-and-routing (a sibling — ONE skill's own description-routing, not composing multiple AGENTS), chat-harness-observability (another sibling — logging/measuring what a run did, not structuring how the agents that did it were composed), chat-harness-knowledge-and-memory (persisting a fact across sessions, not composing agents that act), chat-harness-instructions-and-guardrails (standing instruction layering/enforcement, not multi-agent chain of command), chat-harness-tools-resources-and-services (the tool/resource/service distinction, not agent-to-agent composition), llm-provider-gateway (a single LLM-provider adapter seam, not multi-agent orchestration), llm-jsonl-streaming (parsing one model's own SSE wire format, unrelated to composing agents), plus a genuine build/implement ask (this pack answers, it does not build).
